sources.entry: BlackVault - Open-source proxy gateway for AI API keys. Generate proxy tokens for agents — BlackVault injects the real key server-side and forwards to OpenAI, Anthropic, Google AI, and Nebius AI. Kill a token for instant revocation.

summary.one_liner: BlackVault is an open-source proxy gateway that issues revocable proxy tokens (bvt_) so AI agents can call OpenAI, Anthropic, Google AI, and Nebius without ever seeing the real provider API key.
summary.what_it_does: BlackVault stores provider API keys in an encrypted vault (AES-256-GCM) and hands out bvt_ proxy tokens to agents. Requests sent with a token are checked against per-token limits (rate limits, spend budgets, model allowlists, IP allowlists), then forwarded to the provider with the real key injected server-side. It exposes an OpenAI-compatible endpoint at /api/v1/chat/completions that routes by model name (gpt-*, claude-*, gemini-*, and Nebius-hosted models) and translates request and response formats between OpenAI and Anthropic or Gemini. It also includes a direct proxy route per provider with SSE streaming, a kill switch that revokes a token, session, or everything, and a remote MCP server exposing list_models and chat tools. A /api/health endpoint reports database and Redis status.
use_cases: give AI agents API access without sharing the real key
revoke a single agent's AI API access instantly
cap spending per agent or per token
route OpenAI-compatible tools to Claude or Gemini models
govern MCP client access to AI provider keys
proxy calls to a self-hosted model server such as Ollama or vLLM
notable: Agents hold only a bvt_ proxy token; the real provider key stays server-side, and revoking the token gives an immediate 401
One OpenAI-compatible endpoint auto-routes by model name and translates OpenAI format to Anthropic and Gemini formats
Budget enforcement counts spend in integer nano-dollars atomically, so concurrent requests cannot overshoot by more than one request
Redis failure handling with a circuit breaker and a declared open or closed fail mode, with X-BlackVault-Degraded response header
caveats: Designed around Vercel deployment and Clerk auth; self-hosting needs Postgres and optionally Redis, and without Redis rate limits are off
Some roadmap items are unchecked, including Groq, Mistral, Together AI, webhook alerts, token scoping, analytics, and team workspaces
MCP tools are limited to list_models and chat; generic HTTP-credential brokering is only on the roadmap
